_comment: Cards that exist only for the player-wide absorb test (tests/unit/damage/test_player_damage_prevention.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_heart_herb` is Heart-Shaped Herb's line (a controller-only `damage_source`, which reaches a spell on the stack) and `t_orbs_of_warding` is the second line of Orbs of Warding (a `types` filter, read on the dealer's current characteristics).

cards.name: Test Heart Herb
cards.oracle_text: If a source an opponent controls would deal damage to you, prevent 1 of that damage.

abilities.text: If a source an opponent controls would deal damage to you, prevent 1 of that damage.

cards.name: Test Orbs of Warding
cards.oracle_text: If a creature would deal damage to you, prevent 1 of that damage.
